narr: A warm front helped to focus the remnants of tropical cyclone Beryl which brought steady rainfall and embedded thunderstorms to the region. A cold front then brought a second round of thunderstorms in the evening. Thunderstorms with intense rainfall produced narrow bands of 2-4 inches of rain around the area leading to isolated flash flooding.
